profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Panorama Education

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Panorama Education is a fast-growing national technology company focused on radically improving education. Over 1,500 school systems serving 13 million students across 50 states have adopted the Panorama platform to help educators collect data about non-academic factors that are key to each child’s success in school and in life, such as social-emotional learning and well-being, safety, teacher-student relationships, and family engagement.

To learn more about Panorama Education, visit www.panoramaed.com.

positions.title: Software Engineer Co-op
positions.description: Panorama Education partners with K-12 schools and districts across the country to collect and analyze data about social-emotional learning, school climate, family engagement, and more. With research-backed surveys and a leading technology platform, Panorama helps educators act on data and improve student outcomes. Panorama supports more than 10 million students in 11,500 schools across 48 states, including those in the New York City Department of Education, Dallas Independent School District, Seattle Public Schools, and San Francisco Unified School District. To learn more about Panorama Education, visit www.panoramaed.com.

positions.title: Software Engineer Co-op
positions.description:
At Exabeam I was part of the Incident Responder team, where I:
-	Modified a backend Scala API and a Python end user script to support efficient bulk data deletion and improve ease of use
-	Created a configurable tool to transfer document-oriented metric data into a time-series database
-	Redesigned an existing metrics dashboard using Chronograf to showcase time-series data visualizations
-	Deployed my data collection tool and dashboard to the QA environment using Docker containers
-	Presented my proof-of-concept metrics project to the engineering department as a technology talk

positions.title: Mobile Developer Co-op
positions.description:
As a Mobile Developer Co-op at Rue Gilt Groupe I maintained and updated the Rue La La and Gilt Android Applications, this included: 
- Abstracting parts of the codebase to be common between the two applications
- Implementing Snackbar notifications to provide feedback to user actions
- Redesigning various pages within the applications to improve the user interface and experience
- Adding filtering capabilities to the developer event log within the application to streamline debugging
- Automating the user interface and unit testing for production level code
- Redesigning and building a new unit testing infrastructure for developers

positions.title: Fundamentals of Computer Science 2 Tutor
positions.description:
- Held office hours for two hours a week to assist students with assignments, go over material from lecture, and study for exams
- Assisted in a two hour lab once a week to introduce new topics, guide students through practice problems, and answer questions
- Graded student homework submissions to provide constructive feedback
